newsitem.title: USA: REUTERS PROVIDES PRESS RELEASE SERVICES.
newsitem.headline: REUTERS PROVIDES PRESS RELEASE SERVICES.

text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc said Thursday the U.S.-based PR Newswire and Business Wire services are now available on Reuters terminal products through Reuters' real-time financial news services.
Both services are leaders in the delivery of full-text press releases from U.S.-based companies to the financial and media communities, Reuters said in a statement.
It said Business Wire and PR Newswire are available at no extra cost to clients of Reuters 3000, North American Securities and North American Treasury Plus products worldwide using Reuters terminals.
